reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets small-business owner-operators with a calm, practical tone, reinforces human authority over spending, and follows the strict no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The main point, diagnostic criteria, and boundaries are structured logically and clearly explained on a first read.
reasons.actionability: Gives an immediate, realistic first step to audit active SaaS trials and their tracking locations before adopting any tooling.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, capability, or performance claims, and properly frames automation boundaries around human approval for financial commitments.
